m: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces. Mix with the yoghurt, half the garam masala, the turmeric, chilli powder and 1 tsp salt. Leave 20 minutes or overnight.
Brown the chicken in batches in a hot pan with a little oil. It doesn't need to cook through. Set aside.
Turn the heat down, add the butter and the finely diced onion and cook 8 minutes until soft and golden. Add the grated garlic and ginger, the rest of the garam masala and the cumin for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste for 2 minutes, then the crushed tomatoes and sugar. Simmer 10 minutes, then blitz smooth with a stick blender if you have one.
Add the chicken and cream and simmer 10 minutes until the chicken's cooked through. Taste and season.
Serve over rice with warm naan and coriander.
l: Curry and rice in one container. It reheats perfectly, and the flavour gets better overnight.
g: GF wraps or extra rice instead of naan. Naturally GF otherwise; just check the garam masala label.
